The integration is now in public preview, available starting with… The post GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: You can now work with GitHub Copilot directly in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant , bringing Copilot into your native Xcode workflow. The integration is now in public preview, available starting with Xcode 27.3 beta.
takeaways: The existing GitHub Copilot for Xcode extension remains a separate option, so you can choose the workflow that works best for you.
In Xcode, open Xcode > Settings > Intelligence to set up GitHub Copilot in the coding assistant.
